qa.title: Ask the knowledge base
qa.hint: Answers come only from this tenant's knowledge. Check the sources below and fix any that are wrong.
qa.placeholder: e.g. What is the free shipping threshold?
qa.conflictWarning: Some sources below contradict each other — settle it in Conflict review before trusting this answer.

conflicts.title: Conflict review ({{count}})
conflicts.rationaleWithheld: The explanation was suppressed by a moderation rule. The verdict stands — compare the two documents below.

history.compare: rev {{n}} compared with the current version
history.restoreNote: Restoring is recorded as a new revision; nothing in the history is erased.

importRequiredColumns: Required columns: Product Name · Handle · Detail
importUpsertHint: Existing products are matched by Handle and updated — no duplicates.
importPriceNote: Price is not stored as knowledge: a stale price in an answer is worse than none.
sourceNotReadyHint: This source type cannot ingest yet — no connector is configured.
catalogSyncTitle: Sync knowledge from the product catalog
catalogSyncIntro: Examined {{scanned}} products in the storefront catalog.
catalogHeldHint: No description and no tags — nothing an answer could stand on.
catalogCuratedHint: Hand-edited documents keep their body; only the link and sold-out state are refreshed.
catalogKeepOpenHint: This takes a few minutes. You can close this dialog — the run continues, and reopening shows its progress.
usageGuidesHint: Usage belongs to a type, not a product. Write one per type and it is cited alongside every product of that type.
usageGuideHelp: Write the actual steps and cautions. Leave out anything you are not sure of. Saving indexes it right away, so answers can use it.
usageGuidePlaceholder:
1. Clean and fully dry the nail.
2. Pick the tip that matches your nail size.
3. …

gap.title: Knowledge gap proposals
gap.desc: Escalation-heavy topics, unanswered intents and agent resolutions proposed for the knowledge base. Review, edit and approve — nothing is applied automatically.

folderIdHint: The last part of the Drive folder URL, not the whole link.
shareFolderWith: Share the folder with this address as a viewer:
registerKeyFirst: Register a Google service account key below before adding a Drive source.
gdriveKeyHint: Paste the service account JSON. Only the fields needed to sign in are stored, and the key is never shown again.
gdriveRemoveConfirm: Remove the service account key? Drive sources will stop syncing.
notionTokenStored: A token is stored (last four characters):
notionKeyHint: Paste the internal integration token from notion.so/my-integrations. It is never shown again.
notionRemoveConfirm: Remove the Notion token? Notion sources will stop syncing.
notionSaved: Notion token saved — now connect your page or database to the integration.
notionTargetIdHint: Paste the Notion link or its 32-character ID. A database imports one document per row; a page imports itself and its direct child pages.
shareWithIntegration: In Notion, open the page or database → ⋯ → Connections → add this integration. Without that step it stays invisible.
registerTokenFirst: Register a Notion integration token below before adding a Notion source.
syncDropped: {{count}} page(s) left unconverted by the per-sync cap
syncTruncated: {{count}} page(s) stored with only part of their content
usageTypeKeywordsHint: One per line. Matched against product title, type and tags.
usageTypeNoMatchHint: Nothing matches yet. Check the wording against your product titles.
usageTypeOrderHint: The first matching type claims a product, so put narrower types above broader ones.
usageNoCatalogHint: No catalogue yet, so every count is zero. Guides can still be written and cited.
categoryFromCatalogHint: Created by product sync. Renaming would be undone at the next sync, so it is locked.
categoryMergeHint: Documents move to the target and the emptied categories are deleted.
usageTypeActive: In use (off keeps the guide, stops the matching)
usageTypeTakenHint: {{count}} products match, but "{{type}}" is above this type and takes them. Move this type up, or narrow the keywords.
statusPendingHint: Already used in answers by keyword search; waiting only for the semantic index.
statusLegend: “Pending” documents are already searchable by keyword — only semantic search waits for the index.
sourcesHint: A pipe that keeps external documents in sync. Nothing becomes knowledge until it is synced — for a one-off, "Add KB-Document" is faster.
categoryAgentsTitle: Which agents may use this category
categoryAgentsHint: Agents allowed to cite the {{count}} document(s) filed under "{{name}}".
categoryAgentsNewAgentWarning: An agent created later will not see this category until you add it here.

guide.title: How knowledge gets here
guide.step1Body: Drive or Notion — a pipe, not knowledge.
guide.step2Body: Pulls the pipe in. Until this runs, the source contributes nothing.
guide.step3Body: Written per product type, cited with every product of that type.
guide.step4Body: The only thing an answer is ever grounded in.
guide.noteSource: You can also write a KB-Document directly, sync the catalogue, or import a CSV — all four end in the same place.
guide.noteCategory: A category is both the label and, when you narrow it, which agents may cite it.

help.catalogWhat: Turns the products already in your catalogue into one KB-Document each, so answers can quote them.
help.catalogPreview: A preview shows what would be written before anything is.
help.catalogCategory: The brand becomes the category; these categories are read-only and always available to every agent.
help.catalogVariants: Shade and size variants of one product are folded into a single document.
help.catalogRerun: Safe to re-run: products are matched by handle and updated, never duplicated.
help.csvWhat: Makes one KB-Document per row. Use it when the products are not in the catalogue, or the descriptions live elsewhere.
help.csvUpsert: Rows are matched by Handle and updated — re-uploading the same file creates no duplicates.
help.csvPrice: Price is never stored as knowledge: a stale price in an answer is worse than no price.
help.csvCategory: The category comes from Brand, or Category when Brand is absent.
help.addDocWhat: Writes a document by hand — policies, FAQs, anything an agent should be able to quote.
help.addDocOneTopic: One topic per document. Two answers in one document make both harder to retrieve.
help.addDocWords: Use the words customers use, not internal terms — retrieval matches their question against your text.
help.addDocCategory: The category files it, and decides which agents may cite it if you narrow it.
help.addDocPending: A new document is searchable by keyword immediately; semantic search starts once it is indexed.
